from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingCashInflow(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow from financing activities reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    financing_cash_inflow: float | None = Field(description="The amount of cash inflow from financing activities")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the amount (e.g., '元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this figure covers")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written (e.g., '筹资活动现金流入小计')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_cash_inflows: list[FinancingCashInflow]
